profile_text.body:
Microsoft Research is the research organization of Microsoft, headquartered in Redmond, Washington, and also known as MSR. Its site describes it as conducting fundamental science and technology research across a spectrum of areas, with labs around the globe. The company describes its aim as pursuing breakthroughs across the computing and AI stack to accelerate discovery across sciences and to advance the frontiers of computing and AI so that others can build on the results.

The research areas it lists include artificial intelligence, search and information retrieval, human language technologies, human-computer interaction, computer vision, graphics and multimedia, and audio and acoustics. Its site presents publications, products, downloads, and research careers alongside that work. No specific products are tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed.

The record notes legal exposure in Washington state, with a count of 114, and no individual cases are listed. The organization is recorded as a for-profit research lab.
